unit: article; design=yes if at least one reported study qualifies
pdf_page_convention: 1-based physical PDF page, not printed journal page
optional_per_study_evidence: studies array with study_id and the same evidence objects

interpretation.design: At least one human experiment varies communicated content or question presentation and measures respondents' judgments, attitudes, beliefs, intentions, preferences or comparable survey responses.
interpretation.new_data: Original collection or fielding, separate from secondary analysis; do not infer from design=yes.
interpretation.text_treatment: Written, reading, wording or vignette treatment; mixed modalities may include text.
interpretation.parser_compatible: Assess actual questionnaire structure separately; conjoint/discrete-choice profile combinations and adaptive conversations are incompatible.
interpretation.geography: Respondent location for eligible studies, distinguishing explicit US evidence, contextual inference, non-US and mixed samples.
interpretation.data_possession: Evidence that relevant raw respondent data and materials are available to the researchers; authorship alone does not establish possession.

decision_rule: Do not require every axis to be yes to classify design=yes. Unknown eligibility stays unclear. No original review labels are prefilled.
blinding: Packets omit query routes, sampling strata, author metadata and prior annotations. Authors remain visible within original PDFs/text; author blinding is not claimed.
validation: For each non-unclear decision cite the source PDF hash, an existing page and a short exact evidence span; unclear decisions require an explanatory rationale. AI-assisted judgments cannot be human_validated=true.
